reviews.title: Childhood Dream Comes True!!!
reviews.body: When I was a little kid one of my favorite "special treats" was when I had enough money saved up to ride my bike to the liquor store and buy 4 of these for a dollar. The second I saw them on Amazon for sale, and at the price, I had to have em!!! Bought this one, one in Teriyaki flavor and Teriyaki Beef Sticks. Now every time I go in my kitchen, that favorite childhood "special treat" is just waiting for me to eat way to many! :) I've seen some comments that stated they came stale, hard as a rock. When I ate the first one, the first bite I did sort of stop mid bite and thought "this taste a little weird." Well, it was actually because they were so fresh, my palate was used to the semi or, full on stale stuff I'd been buying for over 30yrs.I ate so many the first day they came in, I ended up putting the jar I had on my kitchen countertop in the pantry because I could not walk by it without at least grabbing one...ok, at least 2...maybe 4;) Good stuff, great price. I think I may just leave a jar open for 24hrs so they do taste a little more stale just like the liquor store ones I am used to. lol

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.body: The Tillamook Country Smoker Real Hardwood Smoked Silver Dollar Beef Jerky, Old Fashioned, 13 Ounce is a truly satisfying snacking experience that combines the rich flavor of traditional smoking techniques with the convenience of a delicious, on-the-go snack. With tender beef strips smoked to perfection using real hardwood, this product offers a deep, savory flavor that lingers on the palate without being overpowering. The 'old fashioned' style is indeed reminiscent of classic beef jerky recipes, with a bold and authentic taste that's sure to please even the most discerning palates. While a bit pricier than other brands in the market, this product is well worth the investment given its high quality ingredients and robust flavor, making it a great choice for jerky enthusiasts looking for a premium snacking option.

reviews.title: A Classic Delight
reviews.body: I recently had the pleasure of enjoying the Tillamook Country Smoker Real Hardwood Smoked Silver Dollar Beef Jerky in the Old Fashioned flavor, and it certainly lived up to its reputation as a classic delight. This jerky is a testament to the brand's commitment to quality and their mastery of the smoking process.The 13-ounce package is filled with an abundance of delicious silver dollar-sized beef jerky pieces. Each bite-sized morsel is perfectly seasoned and smoked with real hardwood, resulting in a rich and robust flavor that is sure to satisfy any beef jerky enthusiast.One of the standout features of this jerky is its texture. The meat is tender and easy to chew, providing a satisfying bite without being overly tough. The smoky flavor permeates each piece, creating a delightful smoky aroma and taste that is reminiscent of traditional, old-fashioned beef jerky.The seasoning of the Old Fashioned flavor is well-balanced, with a savory blend of spices that enhances the natural flavors of the beef. It is not overly salty, allowing the true taste of the meat to shine through. The jerky is also not overly greasy, making it a clean and enjoyable snack option.The resealable packaging ensures that the jerky stays fresh and flavorful even after multiple servings. This is a convenient feature for those who enjoy snacking on jerky throughout the day or for taking on outdoor adventures.While this Tillamook Country Smoker Real Hardwood Smoked Silver Dollar Beef Jerky is undoubtedly delicious, I would have appreciated a slightly larger package size. The 13-ounce package, although generous, may not last long for those with hearty appetites or for sharing amongst a group.In summary, the Tillamook Country Smoker Real Hardwood Smoked Silver Dollar Beef Jerky in the Old Fashioned flavor is a classic delight that showcases the brand's commitment to quality and craftsmanship. Its tender texture, rich smoky flavor, and well-balanced seasoning make it a satisfying snack choice for those craving a taste of traditional beef jerky. Despite the slightly smaller package size, this jerky is a must-try for any beef jerky lover.

reviews.body: Not a negative review but everyone needs to know that this is not a slice of real beef cured like real jerky meat. This is a ground paste that was cooked and then sliced to look like jerky and packaged.Bland taste and looks like _ _ _ treats.

reviews.title: Awesome jerky!
reviews.body: There are generally two kinds of jerky, strips of meat or jerky made from ground meat. This jerky falls into the ground meat category. The flavor is great, traditional salt and pepper sort of style with a nice touch of smoke. The black pepper is on point. I was actually glad to see the usage of MSG as well, it adds a really nice savory flavor to pretty much anything. The jerky is very edible and not tough on the teeth at all, like strips can be. As far as value, jerky can be expensive, but $20ish dollars for the 13ish oz., I feel like this jerky is a steal. I'll have no problem finishing the container and returning for additional orders. Definitely looking forward to trying their other products as well.

reviews.author: R. Willis

reviews.title: Beef Hearts Now Added = Inedible
reviews.body: They changed the ingredients and added in beef hearts to save money. That’s why it tastes so bad now. I bought it from Amazon and Tillamook directly and both are the same. The rep from Tillamook confirmed they added in beef hearts as the main ingredient (obviously to save money.) That is also why you’re seeing a lot of fat deposits now and the slimy texture. I was a long time fan and patron and now won’t buy it unless it’s changed back. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Be aware that containers may contain several hard pieces that cannot be eaten.
reviews.body: Ordered two containers this time and found several hard pieces in each container. These pieces were so hard that they had to go right in the trash. I'm disappointed because I've been ordering these for awhile and these two containers were the worst yet. Not sure if I will be buying anymore. The flavor is good and a great source of protein on the run for a snack. I ordered the pepper flavor before and it was great but I can no longer find it. Be cautious when buying this product because throwing several hard pieces away is not cost effective. This is supposed to be company with high quality products.
